products.name: Debonaire Softy Hardy
description: Our DEBONAIRE Mattress as the name suggests is a model crafted as soft on one side and hard on the other side.
Top side of the mattress is fixed with high density Softy Foam & the other side has high density Rebonded Foam.
This mattress model has a twin benifit that two people sleeping on it can sleep on the side of their choice i.e. soft back or hard back.
This preference will be possible only if two mattresses are made of the total bed size.
Our this model is available in one variant with different thicknesses.

products.name: Spring Series
description: This collection of spring based mattresses are in tune with latest International standards. These mattresses are crafted and architectured to provide the real sleeping luxury and unmatched comfort specifically for those who are more into travelling and are used to sleeping in hotels.
Its numerous high tensile steel springs give proper support to body contours. It also enhances sleeping experience with proper air circulation through air ventilators.
These mattresses have a little Bouncing or Jumping effect, and are commonly used in western countries, hence best for those who want to get feel of International Sleeping Standards.

products.name: Baby Crib Mattress
products.tagline: Gentle support for baby’s growing body
description: Soft comfort serves as the purpose behind creating our baby crib mattresses. The foam base consists of pure softy with a jacquard cotton cover that delivers a comfortable touch. We use pure softy foam with a soft cotton jacquard cover for a cozy feel. We also offer a second option that the style combines softy foam with memory foam which receives additional support from its soft jacquard cover. Also, The Normal size of crib mattress is 47*27.

You may be confident that your child will sleep safely and peacefully with ThankYou Mattresses' premium baby crib mattresses. You may be certain that you are giving your kid a meaningful present with their carefully crafted, professionally designed baby crib mattresses. These mattresses, which are made of premium, non-toxic materials, offer a very soft fit and the ideal ratio of firmness to comfort to support a healthy spine.

With the permeable layers of our baby crib mattress, ventilation is promoted and temperature regulation remains on course so your baby remains cozy and cool throughout the night. Low care needs are combined with durability, and the hypoallergenic material makes it safe and ideal for skin types that are sensitive. In addition to providing parents with piece of mind, our toddler bed mattress, bassinet mattress, and baby crib mattress also keep the infant secure and cozy.

products.name: Fibre Pillow – Plain
description: Get the ultimate support combined with relaxation through our fibre pillows plain pool. These pillows use hypoallergenic high-quality fibre fillings which provide comfort and correct neck alignment along with head position.These pillows look great as decor and also provide good comfort and support as a backrest. They are also a great choice for those who are looking for budget-friendly pillows without compromising on comfort.

products.name: Fibre Pillow – Quilted
description: At Thank You Mattress you can find Fibre Pillows Quilted which deliver superior comfort that lasts through time. A soft quilted design exterior makes these pillows provide outstanding head and neck support with improved softness. Our quilted fibre pillows offer exceptional durability together with superior comfort which provides entire restful relaxation during quality sleep. Experience superior comfort at bedtimes through the combination of perfect soft support.

products.name: Pure Cotton Pillow
description: You will find unparalleled comfort and air circulation through pure cotton pillows. You can find these pillows at premium cotton prices because we utilise natural cotton material to deliver both supportive resilience and luxurious comfort for proper head and neck alignment. These pillows were built for airflow to block heat so you maintain a cool sleeping temperature during the entire night. Ideal for both domestic and hospitality use, these pillows offer exceptional durability and an extended service life. They are also a great choice for those who prefer a traditional and natural sleeping experience.

products.name: Memory Foam Pillow
description: Experience superb comfort with our memory foam pillow that precisely hug your head and neck in position. The memory foam material used in these products adjusts to all your sleeping positions because of its temperature sensitivity helping promote neck alignment and relieve the pressure points. With our memory foam pillow different sleepers can enjoy a firm and plush support options since this pillow eliminates all sleep-related pain. The product delivers supreme comfort together with supportive features for complete nighttime relaxation.

Because of the headrest’s highly permeable design, enhanced airflow is maintained, helping prevent heat buildup during sleep and ensuring a cool, comfortable resting surface throughout the year. The soft, skin-friendly cover adds to the overall comfort and can be easily removed and washed to maintain better hygiene. Designed to suit back- side, and combination sleepers}, this memory foam pillow from ThankYou Mattresses is ideal for daily use and helps significantly improve the quality of your nighttime sleep.

products.name: Memory Contour Pillow
description: The memory contour pillows at Thank You Mattress provides users with pain-free sleep through their design that focuses on neck alignment with pressure relief features. Memory foam absorbs high density material enabling the pillow to conform exactly to head and neck for maximum ergonomic support. Also, It has a breathable hypoallergenic structure which promotes ventilation that prevents the accumulation of body heat to ensure a cool & comfortable rest.

products.name: Rubber Latex Pillow
description: Unrivalled support plus optimal breathability are guaranteed by our top-level rubber latex pillows. The combination of natural and synthetic materials within these products allows them to respond with bounce while moulding to your head and neck for proper neck alignment. A ventilated design in this product creates airflow to stop heat retention which lets you experience restful and cool sleep. Our high-quality rubber latex pillows offer complete restful sleep quality night after night for years.
